The 2002 Radjavi–Rosenthal abstract supplies a nilpotent-commutator triangularizability criterion but not counts; the characterization of possible idempotent commutators by Drnovšek–Radjavi–Rosenthal concerns realizability, rather than counts of pairs with each nilpotency index.
